blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Saul became Paul, who carried the good news across the world and wrote a good part of the New Testament. But that day he was a blind man in a borrowed room, and God sent an ordinary believer to lay hands on him. Nobody is too far gone for God to turn around. And sometimes God sends one of us to be the first to say, brother.
